$:set -euo pipefail
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
ORIG='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png'
test -f "$ORIG"
python3 -m venv /tmp/fishfry_5deg_venv
/tmp/fishfry_5deg_venv/bin/python -m pip -q install Pillow
/tmp/fishfry_5deg_venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
src = Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png')
im = Image.open(src).convert('RGB')
W,H = im.size
assert (W,H) == (1536,1476), (W,H)
strip = im.copy()
current = im.copy()
for i in range(1, 10):
    current = current.rotate(-5, resample=Image.Resampling.BICUBIC, expand=False, fillcolor='white')
    next_strip = Image.new('RGB', (W * (i + 1), H), 'white')
    next_strip.paste(strip, (0,0))
    next_strip.paste(current, (W*i,0))
    strip = next_strip
    target = src.parent / f'pizza_screen_rotations_00_to_{i*5:02d}_step05.png'
    assert not target.exists(), f'Refusing to overwrite: {target}'
    strip.save(target, 'PNG', compress_level=6)
    check = Image.open(target)
    assert check.size == (W*(i+1),H)
    print(f'ITERATION={i} ANGLE={i*5} WIDTH={check.width} HEIGHT={check.height} BYTES={target.stat().st_size} SHA256={sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} FILE={target.as_posix()}',flush=True)
PY
git add -- terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_rotations_00_to_*_step05.png
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -c '^terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_rotations_00_to_')" -eq 9
git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'Generate nine cumulative 5-degree fish fry pizza screen rotations'
git push origin HEAD:main
printf 'PUBLISHED_COMMIT '; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'PUBLISHED_FILES\n'; git show --pretty='' --name-only HEAD | grep '^terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_rotations_00_to_'
printf 'REMOTE_HEAD '; gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha'
outputThat: [main 740ae04] Generate nine cumulative 5-degree fish fry pizza screen rotations
